name: Indian Energy Exchange Ltd
title: Indian Energy Exchange Ltd - 540750 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 volumes hit a record 39.4 BU (+24.3% YoY) and FY26 profit rose 14.9%, but DAM prices fell 12.2% YoY to INR 3.89/unit and market coupling is a live threat to the exchange's price-discovery role.

triggers.label: DAM price down 12.2% YoY
triggers.quote: the prices in the Day Ahead Market at INR 3.89 per unit were down 12.2% year -on-year

triggers.label: Market coupling draft via Grid India
triggers.quote: CERC issued draft regulations for market coupling, according to which Grid India would act as the market coupling operator

triggers.label: Q4 volume record 39.4 BU, +24.3%
triggers.quote: highest ever quarterly traded electricity volume of 39.4 billion units, higher by 24.3% on a year-on-year basis

triggers.label: FY27 volume growth 15-20% (verbal)
triggers.quote: we should be able to maintain this volume growth of 15 % to 20%

triggers.label: Gas exchange Q1 volume flat YoY
triggers.quote: maybe in the first qua rter, we may not get any growth with respect to the last year's first quarter

guidance.quote: we should be able to maintain this volume growth of 15 % to 20%

guidance.value: no growth in Q1 FY27, growth from Q2
guidance.quote: from second quarter onwards, we should be able to achieve growth

red_flags.label: Market coupling could erode DAM share
red_flags.quote: if one exchange data does not get aggregated at the place, then you'll lose significant buy and sell volume

red_flags.label: Other income down ~29% QoQ on treasury MTM
red_flags.quote: there was a significant correction in the market during this month of March. So a bit of mark-to-market impacts were there

evasions.quote: it's very difficult to say on that
there is still no fi nal decision has been taken by SEBI so far
